title: Additivity of uniform expectation
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, the uniform expectation satisfies $\mathbb E_x[f(x)+g(x)]=\mathbb E_x[f(x)]+\mathbb E_x[g(x)]$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$.
Then $\mathbb E[f+g]=\mathbb E[f]+\mathbb E[g]$, where addition of functions is pointwise
and $\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$.
